bio.text: Jason Doucette, a Democrat, has represented District 13 in the Connecticut House of Representatives since 2019 and is on the November 2026 ballot for re-election.
He lives in Manchester, Connecticut (as of September 2019), earned a bachelor's degree from Washington University in St. Louis and a J.D. from the University of Connecticut School of Law.
Doucette is an attorney with the firm of Gagliardi, Doucette & Geraghty.
